description: This file defines the Builder class for managing a content tree. It includes methods for building directory and content structures, ignoring specific files, creating content objects, and sorting and finalizing the tree. The class is part of a larger documentation or content management system.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A utility class for constructing and managing a hierarchical content tree, including directories and pages, with functionality for ignoring specific files, generating content objects, and sorting the structure.

methods.name: isIgnored
methods.description: Determines if a file should be ignored based on its name or directory status.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the filename without extension from a given path.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Recursively builds the directory and content tree starting from a given node, ignoring specified files and directories.

methods.name: createContent
methods.description: Creates a content object (Content or Raw) for a given file within a directory, based on file extension and content validity.

methods.name: removeSortingInformations
methods.description: Removes numeric prefixes or sorting information from filenames to generate clean names or URLs.

methods.name: getOrCreateDir
methods.description: Retrieves an existing directory instance by title or creates a new one under a parent directory.

methods.name: getOrCreatePage
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a page object for a given path within a parent directory, supporting different content types.

methods.name: sortTree
methods.description: Recursively sorts the directory and its subdirectories.

methods.name: finalizeTree
methods.description: Sets next and previous links for all content pages in the directory tree, preparing for navigation.
